channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Govt follows protocol’: BJP respond after Rahul Gandhi remarks on Oppn-Putin meeting
item.description: The startling charge by Rahul Gandhi, while speaking to reporters outside Parliament, comes hours ahead of Russian President Vladimir Putin’s two-day visit to India. His remarks are set to raise eyebrows in the political corridors and also set the stage for heated sparring between the BJP and Congress.

item.title: J&K: Dialysis centre at Raja Sukhdev Singh District Hospital turns lifeline for Poonch residents
item.description: Free dialysis service for families below the poverty line (BPL) under the Pradhan Mantri Dialysis Program has alleviated the sufferings of lakhs of kidney patients across the country, with Jammu and Kashmir (J&K) being no exception.

item.title: Hyderabad Horror, Youth Junaid Stabbed to Death in a Savage Attack by His Own Relatives in Rein Bazar
item.description: A shocking murder in Rein Bazaar shook Hyderabad as youth Junaid was brutally killed with multiple knife attacks. Police revealed that the killers were his own relatives. Full details of the Rein Bazaar brutal murder case here.

item.title: A masjid, a temple, a date adds to Mamata’s political woes in religious tightrope walk
item.description: A yet-to-be-built mosque bearing the name of Mughal emperor Babar, almost five centuries after his death, has come to haunt West Bengal's Trinamool Congress government nearly months before state elections are held next year.

item.title: Finance Minister Sitharaman tables Health & Security Cess Bill 2025 in Lok Sabha
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on Thursday proposed the Health Security se National Security Cess Bill, 2025, which will levy tax on goods like pan masala.

item.title: Salman Khan to add glamour to Telangana Rising Global Summit
item.description: Superstar Salman Khan's presence is set to add glamour to Telangana Rising Global Summit, scheduled to be held here on December 8 and 9.

item.title: Zila Parishad elections: Akali Dal moves HC over viral conference of senior police official
item.description: The SAD president has taken up this issue as one in which the democratic right to vote of a citizen has been snatched by the extra-constitutional actions of the SSP in a planned and premeditated manner to benefit the Aam Aadmi Party.

item.title: Osmania University Police Crack Pre-Planned Murder Case, Three Accused Arrested
item.description: Osmania University Police crack a pre-planned murder case in Hyderabad, arresting three accused linked to the brutal killing of a 58-year-old man. Investigation reveals a shocking conspiracy driven by suspicion of black magic.

item.title: Telangana’s Suhas Wins Gold, Varshith Bags Bronze at SGFI National Swimming Championship
item.description: Telangana swimmers delivered an impressive performance at the 69th SGFI National Swimming Championship 2025–26, being held from November 30 to December 5 at the Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Swimming Stadium in the capital.

item.title: New Cold Wave to Hit Telangana, Temperature May Drop to 3°C in These Areas
item.description: A strong cold wave is set to hit Telangana, and temperatures may drop to as low as 3°C in several northern districts by December 15. IMD warns residents to stay prepared as chilly weather intensifies across Hyderabad and surrounding regions.
